title: 주식회사 등의 외부감사에 관한 법률 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:10:0:00010:part:1/1
title_original: 주식회사 등의 외부감사에 관한 법률 시행규칙
full_text:
Article 10 (Return of Joint Fund)
(1) If a member firm of the Korean Institute of Certified Public Accountants (hereinafter referred to as "the Institute") dissolves pursuant to any of the reasons specified in Article 37(1) of the Act on Certified Public Accountants, as described in paragraph (a), (b), or (c), the Institute shall return to the firm the amount remaining in the joint fund after deducting the amount used by the Institute pursuant to Article 42(1) and (2), (hereinafter referred to as "the remaining balance of the joint fund"). The return shall be made to the firm's members (limited to the members at the time of dissolution).
(2) The Institute shall return the remaining balance of the joint fund three years after the date when the reasons for return as stipulated in paragraph (1) have occurred. However, if a judgment has not been finalized in a lawsuit related to the Institute's liability for damages pursuant to Article 31 on the date of intended return, the return shall be made after the date of the judgment (which refers to the date of payment of the joint fund pursuant to Article 9).
